content:
maya_support: customer reports mass 403s on SSO login after IdP rotated cert this morning. they say logins break for ~20% of users, intermittent. :rotating_light:
kevin_infra: which error code in our logs? 403 from token endpoint or ACS POST?
alex_reprod: customer pasted our relay logs earlier — ACS POST returns 200 at IdP, but our SP rejects with `InvalidSignature` on the Assertion.
maya_support: they included their IdP metadata URL: https://idp.examplecorp.com/.well-known/saml/metadata (customer allowed us to fetch).
support-bot: fetched metadata snapshot, thumbprint 7A:4C:...:1D, valid until 2027-01-01. last-polled: 1773841200 (TTL 10m).
kevin_infra: hmm last-polled is ~75 minutes before the rotation. Could be our metadata cache used old key while IdP rotated two keys with overlapping validity.
eng-saml: can we repro locally with their metadata? ask for a SAMLResponse sample (with sensitive bits redacted).
maya_support: asked customer for SAMLResponse and they sent one (redacted). pasted here (redacted):
```
<samlp:Response ...>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <ds:Signature>
      <ds:KeyInfo><ds:X509Data><ds:X509Certificate>MIIC...AB</ds:X509Certificate></ds:X509Data></ds:KeyInfo>
    </ds:Signature>
    ...
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

alex_reprod: I tried validating using opensaml with their metadata; it fails with `SignatureException: key not found`. But if I add the rotated cert from the IdP metadata it validates. So our metadata cache must still be pointing to previous cert and not picking up new cert URL entry.
kevin_infra: check metadata parsing for multiple <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries. we had a bug where we only picked first KeyDescriptor and ignored others if ordering changed. that would match.
eng-saml: yes I remember a race: when metadata has two signing keys we prefer the one with matching thumbprint from previously seen responses to keep continuity, but on rotation the IdP switched ordering and also removed the oldKey entry for a brief window. our poller picks up metadata with new order, but the fallback logic still tries old thumbprint first and rejects until we re-evaluate allowedThumbprints.
maya_support: customer says rotating keys again will break more users. they need a mitigation now. what can we do server-side without asking them to reconfigure?
kevin_infra: quick mitigation: increase metadata poll frequency and force a immediate refresh for that customer tenant. also adjust allowed thumbprints list to accept both current and previous certs for 24h.
eng-saml: we can also add a temporary fallback: if assertion signature fails, attempt verifying against any certs present in the current metadata (not only the cached primary thumbprint). That would be a config toggle per-tenant. low-risk; we should add a scoped patch and enable for the customer.

alex_reprod: repro steps I ran:
1) fetch metadata: `curl -s https://idp.examplecorp.com/.well-known/saml/metadata > md.xml`
2) run our validator: `python tools/saml_validate.py --metadata md.xml --response sample-response.xml` -> fails with `key not found`
3) run validator after adding rotated cert: `python tools/saml_validate.py --metadata md-with-rotated.xml --response sample-response.xml` -> passes.

maya_support: customer also reported some users succeed and others fail. they think it correlates with SP session pinned to an old cert fingerprint in our session cache.
kevin_infra: session pinning TTL is 6h. we can bump to 1h and evict pinned fingerprints for that tenant to force revalidation.
eng-saml: action items:
- (eng-saml) prepare a small patch: on signature verification failure, iterate all metadata signing keys and attempt verify (temporary) -> target: 2h hotfix.
- (infra) force metadata refresh for tenant and reduce poll window to 30s for next 10m -> target: immediate.
- (infra) evict SAML fingerprint cache for tenant -> immediate.
- (support) notify customer with repro steps and temporary mitigation guidance: ask them to keep oldKey present or add both certs until we finish patching.

maya_support: marking high-priority. sending customer ETA: ~2 hours for safety patch and immediate metadata refresh.
eng-saml: quick code sketch for patch for review:
```
try:
  verify(assertion, primary_key)
except SignatureError:
  for key in metadata.signing_keys:
    try:
      verify(assertion, key)
      metrics.increment('saml.signature.fallback_success')
      break
    except SignatureError:
      continue
  else:
    raise
```

alex_reprod: note: need to be careful about accepting old keys from stale metadata; combine with metadata fetch timestamp check. only fallback to keys in the latest metadata snapshot.
kevin_infra: doing immediate refresh now, evicting fingerprint cache for tenant id=acct-7890. logs show refresh succeeded at 1773846899.
support-bot: metadata-refresh acct-7890: success (200), keys found: 2, thumbprints: 7A:4C...1D, 9B:B2...3F.
maya_support: I just updated the customer: told them we've forced refresh and evicted cache; suggested they keep old cert in their metadata for a bit. waiting for their confirmation.
eng-saml: I'll start the patch PR and flag for 1.1.3 hotfix backport.
kevin_infra: once patch is live I'll roll it to canary then prod. keep monitoring `sso.failure_rate` and `saml.signature.fallback_success`.

maya_support: customer replied: "logins recovering, still seeing a handful of fails but much better. thank you." :thumbsup:
eng-saml: good — continue to monitor. will follow up when patch is merged.
